name: mystic_forge_idiom_casts_artifact_creature_on_opponents_turn
note: Diagnostic: on P1's turn, P0 activates the free 'cast from the top' row of Mystic Forge with Prismite (an artifact creature, sorcery timing) on top of the library. Printed Mystic Forge does not change timing (CR 601.3), so the cast must not happen.
